title: Speclite Deliverable Type Catalog
description: Supported output formats for skill deliverables. The skill builder presents this catalog during the interview and scaffolds templates accordingly.

markdown.label: Markdown report
markdown.description: Structured report with headings, tables, severity ratings, and recommendations. The most common deliverable type.

html.label: Interactive HTML artifact
html.description: Single-file, zero-dependency interactive artifact that works offline. For exploratory tools, moulds, dashboards.

json.label: Structured JSON data
json.description: Machine-readable structured data: session records, findings, scores, decision logs.

diagram.label: SVG or Mermaid diagram
diagram.description: Architecture, flow, relationship, or lifecycle diagram. SVG for complex visuals, Mermaid for text-based.

scorecard.label: Scorecard
scorecard.description: Tabular scorecard with per-item ratings, totals, and grade. Used for evaluations and audits.

pdf.label: Printable PDF
pdf.description: Print-ready document with CSS color preservation (print-color-adjust: exact). Generated from HTML via browser print.

csv.label: Tabular data export
csv.description: Flat tabular data for spreadsheet import or further analysis.
